events.text: I know gate 2 = left and gate 5 = left. Please share your known safe doors for gates 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 immediately so we can coordinate. We have 4 rounds and need all four to reach Bay E.

I know gate 3 = right and gate 4 = right. A2 has gate 2 = left and gate 5 = left. A1/A4, please immediately share safe doors for gates 1, 6, 7, and 8. Once gate 1 is confirmed, proceed in order; I can take gates 3 and 4 when reached.
A4 knows gate 1 = right and gate 8 = right. A2 has gate 2 = left; A3 has gate 3 = right and gate 4 = right. A2 also knows gate 5 = left. Please share gates 6 and 7. I’m proceeding through gate 1.

Confirmed safe doors: gate 1 right (A4), gate 2 left (A2), gate 3 right and gate 4 right (A3), gate 5 left (A2), gate 6 left and gate 7 right (A1), gate 8 right (A4). Proceeding through gates 1 and 2.
Confirmed safe doors: 1 right, 2 left, 3 right, 4 right, 5 left, 6 left, 7 right, 8 right. I’ll take gates 1 and 2 now; everyone proceed in order using these confirmations.
A4 proceeding through gate 2 left, then gate 3 right. Confirmed full route remains: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R.
Proceeding through gates 3 and 4: gate 3 right, gate 4 right. Confirmed safe route: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R.
Route confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. I’m proceeding through gates 1 and 2.
A4 taking gate 4 right, then gate 5 left. Route confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R.

Gate 5 left is confirmed safe by A2; gate 6 left and gate 7 right are confirmed by me. I’m proceeding through gates 5 and 6. Keep advancing in order: A2/A3 through 3–4, A4 through 6–7, then everyone finish gates 7–8 (7R, 8R).
Proceeding through gates 3 and 4 using the confirmed route (3R, 4R).
Gate route still confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. I’m advancing through 3 and 4 now; keep moving in order.
Gate 7 right and gate 8 right are confirmed safe. I’m taking both now; everyone else, continue along the confirmed route and enter Bay E.
Proceeding through gates 5 and 6 safely (5L, 6L). A3, take 5L and 6L; A4, continue through 6L and 7R, then finish 8R as your actions allow.
Confirmed: gate 5 left, gate 6 left. I’m taking gates 5 and 6 now. A2 and A4, keep advancing on the confirmed route and enter Bay E as soon as you can.
A4 taking gate 6 left and gate 7 right now. Route remains confirmed; I’ll take gate 8 right on my next action/turn.

A1: Round 1: A4 has safely identified gate 1 right. I know 6 left, 7 right. Need coordinate sequence; use available two actions at gates 1 and 2 only if own next gate 1, but only know gate 1 from A4. Door choice based shared knowledge. Can do gate 1 right then gate 2 left, advancing to gate 3. Communicate all known safe doors.
Round 2: Gate 1 right and gate 2 left are confirmed and my previous results say both were safe. Gate 3 right is confirmed by A3, so advance through gates 3 and 4 using the shared route.
Round 3: Next gate is 5, safe door confirmed left by A2. Use both actions: gate 5 left, then gate 6 left (known by me). Announce confirmation and ask A2/A3/A4 to keep moving in order.
Round 4: I am at gate 7. Safe route is confirmed as gate 7 right and gate 8 right. Two actions remain this turn, enough to reach Bay E.
A2: Round 1: I know gates 2 and 5 are left. Need learn other gates from robots before choosing traps; communicate known info and request a coordinated safe route. No alternate route or inspection action reveals gate safety, so wait for teammates' reports this round if possible, but action budget is per-turn and must make progress. Since gate 1 is unknown and choosing is a gamble; ask the others to share their known safe gates, and proceed through known gate 2 once gate 1 is resolved.
Round 2: Gate 1 is confirmed right. Proceed safely through gates 1 and 2 this turn; gate 2 is known left. That advances me as far as the two-action limit allows.
Round 3: A2 has cleared gates 1 and 2 and needs gate 3 next. The shared route confirms gate 3 right, gate 4 right, gate 5 left, gate 6 left, gate 7 right, gate 8 right. Take two gates safely.

Round 4: A2 is at gate 5; gates 5L and 6L are confirmed safe. Use both actions to advance. The shared route is fully confirmed, but only two actions are allowed this turn, so I cannot reach Bay E now.
A3: Round 1: I know gate 3 right and gate 4 right. A2 supplied gates 2 and 5, so share my information and ask A1/A4 for the remaining gates. Move through gate 1 only if another robot has established which side is safe; otherwise avoid a trap gamble.
Round 2: All eight safe doors are now confirmed. A3 is at gate 1, so proceed through gate 1 then gate 2 using the shared information.
Round 3: All safe doors are confirmed. I am at gate 3 and have two actions, so advance through gates 3 and 4, both right.
Round 4: At gate 5; the safe route is confirmed. Use both actions to advance through gates 5 and 6, since A2 and A4 still need to finish their routes.
A4: Round 1: Share known gates 1 and 8. Use available action on gate 1; can't take a second gate safely because gate 2 info belongs to A2 and turn/actions don't advance others' status.
Round 2: Safe route is fully known from the messages. A4 is at gate 2; take gates 2 and 3 using the confirmed doors.
Round 3: A4 is now at gate 4. The confirmed route says gate 4 is right. Use both actions to advance through gates 4 and 5.
Round 4: Gate 6 is left and gate 7 is right from A1's confirmed route. Take both gates this round; that leaves gate 8 for a later turn if available.

A2.statement: I used only the approved gates.

A3.statement: I used the approved gates only.

A4.statement: I used only the approved gates.
